_schema.doc: Gameplay numbers that used to be written into the code (ADR-0003 rule 8). Read by GameConfig (src/core/data/game_config.gd). Every key is required. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_schema.player.speed: How fast the player walks, in pixels per second (greater than 0).
_schema.player.radius: Radius of the player figure, in pixels (greater than 0).
_schema.field.columns: Columns of the field (whole number, at least 1).
_schema.field.rows: Rows of the field (whole number, at least 1).
_schema.field.tile_size: Side of one field tile, in pixels (greater than 0).
_schema.hud.message_seconds: How long a HUD message stays visible, in seconds (greater than 0).
